_notes: Locally added for the leaderboards of VPX -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for Peyper/Sonic games.
Found by watching every byte of the RAM (0x6000-0x67FF) through an automated 2-player game (Doc/test-hooks/score-probe.py).
Scores: 3 bytes of packed BCD, most significant first, from 0x6150 on a 3-byte stride. 0x6150 and 0x6153 went to 0 at the start
and rose with players 1 and 2 only (final 228,600 / 338,700 in memory); players 3 and 4 follow the stride.
scale 10: the 7-digit displays show the 6 digits of the memory followed by a constant 0 (sonicDisp7 in PinMAME peypergames.c:
the 7th digit is segment 36, set to 0 by peyper.c).
player_count 0x6137 (0, then 1 and 2 at each start, 0 at the end); 0x60D4 is 1 during a game and 0 otherwise (game_over);
